first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation, with prior evidence of durable adoption gains. Promotional pricing is the strongest alternative given competitive pressure, but its impact on long-term customer quality, retention, and post-discount revenue is unclear; verify both records before committing.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding-simplification experiment. The verified source directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, aligning with sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitor pressure because its verified cohort suffered 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Activation messaging remains plausible for the activation decline, but onboarding simplification has stronger verified downstream evidence and may improve activation through faster time-to-value.
